name: alphanumeric
whatItDemonstrates: A 6-slot recovery-code field where validationType="alphanumeric" accepts both letters and digits.
stateManaged: none — static markup; only React.useId for the label/description ids
nonTrivialInteractions: validationType="alphanumeric" filters accepted characters to letters and digits
native <label> associated via the Root id; the first slot omits aria-label while slots 2-6 announce 'Character N of 6'

aria-describedby points at a

describing the accepted format (e.g. A7C9XZ)

name: custom-sanitize
whatItDemonstrates: A recovery-code field whose normalizeValue uppercases letters, with rejected-character feedback via onValueInvalid (screen-reader message plus a temporary highlight pulse on the focused slot).
stateManaged: uncontrolled OTP value; demo-level state lives in the shared useInvalidFeedback hook (useState for focusedIndex, invalidPulse, and statusMessage, plus a timeout ref and a skip-clear ref)
nonTrivialInteractions: normalizeValue={toUpperCase} runs after validationType="alphanumeric" filtering to uppercase input

onValueInvalid sets an aria-live="polite" status message, increments a pulse counter whose even/odd value alternates invalid class names to retrigger the highlight animation on the focused slot, and resets the pulse after 400ms
a skip-clear ref makes the onValueChange fired by the rejected keystroke skip clearing the feedback, so the message survives until a genuine change or the timeout
per-slot onFocus tracks the focused index so the highlight pulse targets the active slot
discrepancies: No tailwind variant exists for this demo; the cssModules implementation is the only variant.

name: focused-placeholder
whatItDemonstrates: A 6-slot verification field where each slot shows a '•' placeholder that becomes transparent only while that slot is focused.
stateManaged: none — static markup; only React.useId for the label/description ids
nonTrivialInteractions: the native placeholder prop on the real input renders a hint in every slot
CSS focus styling (focus:placeholder:text-transparent in tailwind; &:focus::placeholder in css modules) hides the hint only on the active slot

name: grouped
whatItDemonstrates: A 6-slot code split into two groups of three around a custom dash Separator for a 123-456 presentation.
stateManaged: none — static markup; only React.useId for the label id
nonTrivialInteractions: arbitrary wrapper <div> elements around subsets of slots do not affect slot counting or navigation
OTPField.Separator renders its dash inline between the groups without counting as a slot
slots 4-6 all carry aria-label ('Character N of 6'); only slot 1 relies on the shared label

name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: The canonical minimal OTP field: a labeled 6-slot code entry with supporting description text.
stateManaged: none — static markup; only React.useId for the label/description ids
nonTrivialInteractions: native <label> associated via the Root id names every slot
slots 2-6 get aria-label 'Character N of 6'; the first slot inherits the shared label

name: password
whatItDemonstrates: A 6-slot access-code field where the mask prop obscures typed characters like a password input.
stateManaged: none — static markup; only React.useId for the label/description ids
nonTrivialInteractions: mask renders every slot as an obscured password-type input while keeping per-slot entry behavior
